content: In a final step, we update the tokenizer to account for the added words. Let $\mathcal {T}_\mathrm {LM}$ be the standard BERT tokenizer, and let $\hat{\mathcal {T}}_\mathrm {LM}$ be the tokenizer that treats all words in $\mathbb {L}_\mathrm {LM} \cup \mathbb {L}_\mathrm {W2V}$ as one-wordpiece tokens, while tokenizing any other words as usual.
